title: Agricultural and Biorenewable Systems Management, B.S. (College of Agricultural Sciences)
notes: University Park. The entire ABSM department catalog was missing -- added minimal entries in new absm_catalog.json sourced from PSU course description pages. Several ABSM courses (350/391/392/426/429/490) list '5th/7th-semester standing' prerequisites the planner schema doesn't model directly (no semester-standing concept, only course-code prereqs) -- these are scheduled in their bulletin-intended later terms by author placement rather than an enforced prereq gate, same limitation as every other major's 'First-Year Seminar' style items. Where the bulletin gives a real course-code chain (ABSM 392 needs 391; 430W needs 391+392; 431W needs 430W; 422/428 need 301) that chain is fully encoded. Handbook cross-check: the ABSM Advising Manual (abe.psu.edu/undergraduate/resources/advising/absm-manual, cited by the bulletin itself) is a real department resource. Its 'Course Selection Lists' sub-page is the broad, multi-department 'Additional Specialization Elective' pool (180+ courses across ~17 departments, adviser-guided, no single enumerated list to hard-code) -- confirmed correctly left generic. But the bulletin's own text for the OTHER pool is a real, closed, enumerated list: 'Select 12 credits of ABSM courses from the following: ABSM 310, 320, 327, 402, 411, 417, 420, 423, 424, [or] 496' -- all ten exist in absm_catalog.json. Wired the 4 'ABSM Selection Elective' slots (12cr total, matching exactly) via the engine's 'match' field, same treatment as CMPSC's curated technical-elective category. Semester 1's fetched credit total (15.5) didn't match the sum of its listed items (12.5) -- added an extra 3cr GEN ED item to close the gap, likely dropped by the extraction; re-verified directly against the live bulletin during this pass -- the same 5 named items (ABSM 100/CHEM 110/EDSGN 100/MATH 140/GEN ED GHW) still only sum to 12.5 against the bulletin's own stated 15.5 total, so this remains a real bulletin-table extraction gap, not a misplaced ECON 104 (ECON 104 is real and correctly in Semester 2's Spring row on the live bulletin, matching this plan already -- moving it to Semester 1 would break an already-correct match, not fix one). Post-parens-fix re-scrape (AND/OR prereq-parsing bug fix) revealed CHEM 110, ACCTG 211, and STAT 200 all have real, previously-hidden math prereqs the plan never satisfied: ACCTG 211/STAT 200 need MATH 21, and CHEM 110 needs MATH 22, which itself needs MATH 21, which needs MATH 4, which needs MATH 3 -- none of these were in the plan, permanently blocking all three downstream courses (and CHEM 111, which needs CHEM 110 concurrently). Added the full real chain explicitly: MATH 3 (Semester 1), MATH 4 (Semester 2), MATH 21 (Semester 3), MATH 22 (Semester 4) -- same convention used for LSCPE's identical gap. Adds 12cr beyond the bulletin's own stated total, documented rather than silently absorbed. Bumped max_credits_per_semester to 18 to keep the resulting load realistic given the additions, same pattern used elsewhere this session (e.g. AIE).
